card.title: Rightful Place
card.instruction: Carry yourself as the rightful holder of your role and treat any demand for proof as an insult.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put my nameplate on the allotment committee chair. Let's start.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Have you got the result sheet? I need to verify who's chairing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You want me to prove I'm entitled to my own chair?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll call the secretary. She can confirm it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put her on speaker. Once she's confirmed me, I'll ask her to minute your apology.
